# Rostas

> Volunteer roster software for churches and community groups in New Zealand.
> Rostas builds fair rosters, finds replacements automatically when someone
> can't make it, and gives volunteers a simple app. Made in New Zealand.

## What it does
- Collects each volunteer's availability and how often they're happy to serve
- Builds a roster that honours those limits and spreads the load fairly
- When someone declines, asks the next eligible person one at a time, by app
  notification or text, until someone accepts, then tells the coordinator
- Volunteer app at mobile.rostas.app: installs from a link on Android and
  iPhone, no app store and no password. Volunteers without it get emails and
  texts with a link
- Roster Board for coordinators: the whole season on one screen

## Who it's for
Churches first. Also sports clubs, community meals, school PTAs and other
groups running recurring volunteer rosters.

## How it runs
Rostas runs in a Google Sheet in the organisation's own Google account. The
volunteer list and rosters stay there. It can sync volunteers from Infoodle,
Planning Center or a Google Sheet, or import from any CSV or spreadsheet.

## Availability and pricing
- New Zealand, by invitation while Rostas is in beta. Australia to follow.
- Beta: no subscription charge. Texts are prepaid at 12.5c each (packs from
  NZ$31.25 for 250). App notifications and emails are free.
- After the beta: NZ$30 a month or NZ$299 a year, after a 30-day free trial.
  At least 30 days' notice before the beta ends.
